items.title: Ida Goodson Interview, 1961-05-06
items.q: Yeah, my sister played with him, Bob. I went to work one time in her place

ctx.x: That's him, I know. That's what that's ever all. That's what that's ever all. Yeah, my sister played with him, Bob. I went to work one time in her place, because she got a booze there and couldn't go, so I went to work one time, but I never played too much with that bunch. She got a what?
You know Ed Dick. What's a booze-an?
